name: Theta Bootis
description: A naked-eye star 14.5 parsecs away, 1.7 times the Sun's width: its disc was measured with the CHARA Array.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 126660: radius in solar radii, from the limb-darkened angular diameter 1.109 +/- 0.007 mas (CHARA) and the Hipparcos parallax, 1.733 +/- 0.011

mass.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 126660: mass in solar masses, from Yonsei-Yale isochrones at the measured radius and temperature (a model value), 1.232 +/- 0.058

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 126660: effective temperature in K, from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux, 6265 +/- 41

distance.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 126660: the Hipparcos parallax the radius was computed with (van Leeuwen 2007), 68.83 +/- 0.14 mas, inverted

text.card: A naked-eye star 15 parsecs away whose disc the CHARA Array measured: 1.7 times the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Its disc spans 1.109 milliarcseconds, which gives 1.733 solar radii and 6,265 K at its surface.
text.locator: Tables 5 and 10, HD 126660: limb-darkened diameter, R, Teff
